Accompaniment Patterns

A lesson for every bass line, comping rhythm, drum groove and conga part the band plays

Every pattern the Backing Track band can play has a lesson here. Each one starts from simpler patterns in the same list, plays every step on the band and writes out what it played, then takes the pattern into its styles and shows how it relates to the rest. A pattern marked ○ is a starting point: it builds on nothing else.

Bass lines

Jazz

  • Walking — from Roots on 1 and 3 → Two-feel → Chord tones (learning to walk)
  • Chord tones (learning to walk) — from Roots on 1 and 3 → Roots on every beat
  • Two-feel — from Roots on 1 and 3
  • Boogaloo riff — from Roots on 1 and 3 → Dotted (1, and of 2, 3)
  • Boogaloo riff, walking at times — from Boogaloo riff → Chord tones (learning to walk) → Walking

From tunes

  • So What: the bass call — from Held roots (the bass voice) → Two-feel
  • Killer Joe: two-bar vamp — from Roots on 1 and 3 → Two-feel
  • Song for My Father: root, fifth, octave — from Roots on 1 and 3 → Dotted (1, and of 2, 3)
  • Footprints: waltz ostinato — from Root and fifth → Chord tones (learning to walk)
  • All Blues: 6/8 vamp — from Held roots (the bass voice) → 12/8 ballad
  • Chameleon: chromatic pickup — from Held roots (the bass voice) → Roots on every beat
  • Maiden Voyage: roots on the rhythm — from Roots on 1 and 3 → Dotted (1, and of 2, 3)
  • Take Five: 3 + 2 — from Held roots (the bass voice) → Roots on 1 and 3

Folk, rock and pop

  • Roots on every beat — from Held roots (the bass voice) → Roots on 1 and 3
  • Root and fifth — from Roots on 1 and 3
  • Root and fifth on every beat — from Root and fifth → Roots on every beat
  • 3+3+2 (tresillo) — from Roots on 1 and 3 → Dotted (1, and of 2, 3)
  • Root eighths — from Roots on 1 and 3 → Roots on every beat
  • Dotted (1, and of 2, 3) — from Roots on 1 and 3 → Roots on every beat
  • Octaves (disco) — from Roots on every beat → Root eighths
  • Motown: root, fifth, octave — from Root and fifth → Dotted (1, and of 2, 3)
  • 12/8 ballad — from Roots on 1 and 3 → Two-feel

Hymns and carols

  • ○ Held roots (the bass voice)
  • Roots on 1 and 3 — from Held roots (the bass voice)

Latin

  • Bossa nova — from Roots on 1 and 3 → Root and fifth
  • Tango (habanera) — from Roots on 1 and 3 → Dotted (1, and of 2, 3)
  • Tumbao — from Root and fifth → Bossa nova
  • Cha-cha — from Roots on 1 and 3 → Root and fifth
